scope: Independent OOXML cell/CSV equality, source hashes, cutoffs, units and reference-plane circuit algebra. Primary article wording, instrumentation calibration and licenses are ledger-reviewed, not independently remeasured or newly reverified here.
limitations: Composite source S21 includes fixture, electrical-to-optical conversion and receiver response; no unique intrinsic lifetime follows.

200 fF and 50 ohm are explicit illustrations, not fits or actual A-route impedance.
Physical-pixel pairing, measurement temperature, receiver deembedding and S21 phase remain unknown.
No model switch or route ranking is justified by this extraction alone.
recommendations: Keep old baseline frozen; use new model ID plus DC and coupled regression for any future fit.
Retain complete-chain versus deembedded-block alternatives and never count RC/RX twice.
